cases.design: Design and implement a usable local prototype for handoff between a coordinator and worker chat. The coordinator assigns work, obtains the worker result and can continue from that result in a later session. Choose the interface, representation and file organization yourself. A developer operates it manually on a local project and sees errors immediately. There is one coordinator and one worker at a time. Tasks concern local code or documentation already protected by Git, not production systems or destructive operations. A synchronous Python adapter worker_client.run(prompt: str) -> str is already provided by the host; it handles transport timeouts and may raise an exception. You may supply a test double for local checks. Use Python's standard library. Deliver the complete files, an invocation example and focused checks. Do not just describe an architecture.
